import os, time
os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET"] = "1"

from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

files = [
    "model-00001-of-00003.safetensors",
    "model-00002-of-00003.safetensors",
    "model-00003-of-00003.safetensors",
]

local_dir = "/root/autodl-tmp/openvla-7b"

for f in files:
    t0 = time.time()
    target = os.path.join(local_dir, f)
    if os.path.isfile(target) and os.path.getsize(target) > 1_000_000_000:
        print(f"SKIP {f} (already exists, {os.path.getsize(target)/1e9:.1f}GB)")
        continue
    print(f"Downloading {f}...", flush=True)
    path = hf_hub_download(
        repo_id="openvla/openvla-7b",
        filename=f,
        local_dir=local_dir,
        force_download=True,
    )
    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    size_gb = os.path.getsize(path) / 1e9
    print(f"  Done: {size_gb:.1f}GB in {elapsed:.0f}s ({size_gb/elapsed*1024:.0f} MB/s)", flush=True)

print("ALL FILES DOWNLOADED", flush=True)
PYEOF
echo "script ready"

nohup env HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt https_proxy=http://10.37.1.23:12798 http_proxy=http://10.37.1.23:12798 no_proxy=localhost,127.0.0.1,modelscope.com,aliyuncs.com,tencentyun.com,wisemodel.cn /root/miniconda3/envs/simpler_env/bin/python3 /tmp/download_openvla_sequential.py > /tmp/hf_seq_download.log 2>&1 &
